name: smart-vaccination-system
description: Smart Vaccination System using Drone Unified with Robotic Arm

scripts.start: echo "Please choose a service to start:" && echo "  npm run start:server  - Start Node.js backend" && echo "  npm run start:client  - Start React frontend" && echo "  npm run start:ml      - Start Python ML service" && echo "  npm run dev           - Start all services (requires concurrently)"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client && npm run install:ml
scripts.dev: echo "Install concurrently first: npm install" && concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client" "npm run start:ml"
